If you pull Esme early, she is a fantastic "safety net" hero. Her boosted health acts like a shield, making difficult map stages much easier. Prioritize her if you struggle against Season 4 (Underwild) biome effects or specific fiend bosses.

Esme is a "Toolbox Hero." You won't use her every day. You likely won't put her on defense. But for that one specific war hit where you face a double-fiend defense, she is the MVP. Do not prioritize Limit Breaking her unless you lack other 5-star healers. She does her job effectively at 4/80 +20 emblems.
Upon release, players brutally roasted Esme, calling her "a 5* vanilla Hawkmoon outside of fiends." This sentiment drove the push for her buff.

A common community debate is Esme vs. the 4-star Wang Yuanji. Many argued Wang was better because she overhealed (before Esme's buff). Now, Esme is seen as the "big sister" version, though Wang remains more accessible.

Esme is the definition of a "specialist." In a vacuum, she is an average healer with aging stats. But in her element—facing down a board full of spiders, moths, or gargoyles—she is absolutely peerless. She turns a stressful mechanic into a trivial one. While she may not be the flashiest hero in your roster, you will be incredibly thankful you have her when the dreaded "Fiend Meta" rears its head in your war matchups.
A solid, reliable A-tier specialist who belongs on the bench until she is needed—at which point, she becomes S-tier.
